messages:
sam (Vendor Risk): Quick gating Q: does Redwood support HSM-backed customer-managed keys and can you provide CAIQ-friendly custody language + proof of rotation?
maria (Sales): Yes. We support BYOK via cloud KMS or HSM for Private. Looping Aj + Kevin for text and evidence.
aj (Solutions Eng): Short tech: we use envelope encryption (DEK per-tenant). DEKs are generated by Redwood and wrapped with your CMK. CMKs stay in your KMS/HSM; Redwood never has plaintext master keys. TLS 1.3 protects data in transit.
kevin (Security): Evidence we can provide: KMS resource IDs, rotation timestamps, audit-log slices of Wrap/Unwrap, and a signed rotation manifest (SHA256 + Redwood signature). For on-prem HSMs we can show PKCS#11 call logs.
sam (Vendor Risk): Can you paste a one-line CAIQ answer I can drop in the form?
aj (Solutions Eng): "Encryption: Data at rest is protected with AES-256-GCM. Per-tenant DEKs are generated by Redwood and wrapped with customer-managed master keys (CMKs) held in the customer's KMS/HSM. Redwood does not store plaintext CMKs or unwrapped master keys. In-transit encryption uses TLS 1.3. Key operations are logged and exportable."
maria (Sales): PoC recommendation: 10-working-day tech validation to test key integration, a rotation event, and latency benchmark. Note: BYOK/HSM on Dedicated/Private is an SOW add-on.
kevin (Security): SLA note for reviewers: typical wrap/unwrap against managed KMS ~10-40ms; on-prem HSM may vary and we use a short-lived DEK cache to reduce tail latency.
artifact-bot: PoC template uploaded: https://redwood.docs/internal/poc/byok-template (permissions: sales,security)
sam (Vendor Risk): Great, thanks. Please attach the CAIQ snippet + audit sample when you send the SOW.
